gcp.secretmanager.access.note: Access operations; the first 10,000 a month are free and ignored. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set. The SKU's list unit is unconfirmed.

gcp.secretmanager.versions.note: Active secret version per location (about $0.06 a month); automatic replication counts as one location. The first 6 versions are free and ignored. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set. The SKU's list unit is unconfirmed.
